categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Alltest Biotech Co., Ltd. focuses on the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, specializing in point-of-care testing (POCT) rapid diagnostic reagents. Its main product lines include drug abuse detection, infectious disease detection, women's health, tumor markers, and cardiac markers. The company also develops biochemical diagnostics, chemiluminescence, immunoblotting, electronic instruments, and molecular diagnostics platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed eight core technology platforms including biological raw materials, POCT rapid diagnostics, biochemical, chemiluminescence, electronic instruments, immunoblotting, molecular diagnostics, and biosensor electrochemical technologies. Key proprietary technologies include monoclonal antibody preparation, nano-scale immunogold labeling, time-resolved immunofluorescence, dry chemical analysis, and automated chemiluminescence immunoassays. Production strictly follows medical device and IVD quality standards with full quality control from raw materials to finished products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include overseas medical device brand owners and manufacturers, hospitals, pharmacies, national laboratories, police, military, and customs agencies. The company serves over 160 countries and regions, with strong presence in Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, and domestic Chinese markets. The sales model includes ODM for international clients and self-owned brands for domestic markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hangzhou and multiple subsidiaries domestically and internationally. Overseas markets include North America, Europe, Australia, Canada, Brazil, and Southeast Asia. It has subsidiaries and branches in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and other countries, supporting global sales and marketing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Alltest operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of diagnostic reagents and instruments. It also produces key biological raw materials such as antigens and antibodies, reducing dependence on upstream suppliers and enhancing supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with significant R&D investment (16.06% of revenue in 2023). It focuses on developing new diagnostic reagents, expanding product lines, and obtaining international certifications (FDA 510K, CE, MHRA, MDL, TGA). Future R&D priorities include gene sequencing, multi-omics, nanobiotechnology, biosensors, and digital health integration. The company also pursues automation, intelligent diagnostics, and global market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of diagnostic reagents and instruments. The company uses an ODM model for international clients, producing products under clients' brands, and self-owned brand sales domestically. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and transfer of control to customers, with contracts typically involving product sales rather than subscription or licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Alltest is a leading supplier in the global POCT rapid diagnostic reagent market, competing with international giants like Roche, Abbott, Siemens, and Danaher in certain segments. It holds a strong position in drug abuse detection globally and has competitive advantages in biological raw material production. The company is recognized as a key player in China’s fast-growing IVD market with expanding international influence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 754.7 million, a 77.73% decrease from 2022 due to reduced COVID-19 antigen test demand. Excluding COVID-19 products, core business revenue grew 26.91%. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 180.6 million, down 84.76%. The company has total assets of RMB 4.12 billion and equity of RMB 3.83 billion. Despite short-term declines, the company maintains strong R&D investment and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Alltest emphasizes rapid, accurate, and diverse POCT diagnostic solutions with over 1,200 product types covering multiple disease areas. Its proprietary biological raw material technology ensures stable supply and cost advantages. The company’s global certifications and innovative products, including several global firsts in drug detection, differentiate it in the competitive IVD market. Its integrated technology platforms and strong international presence provide comprehensive diagnostic solutions tailored to diverse customer needs.
